decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for
purposes incidental (such as for storage purposes or a gym) to the enjoyment of
the first floor flat located at 127 Bellamy Drive, Stanmore, Harrow, HA7 2DG
and shall not be used as a separate unit of residential accommodation, without
the prior permission in writing of the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residents
and the character of the locality as required by policy DM1 of the Harrow
Development Management Policies Local Plan 2013.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved
details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding
seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the
development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs
which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die,
are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the
next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the
local authority agrees any variation in writing. The boundary treatment
including the side gate shall be completed before the development is occupied.
The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To safeguard the appearance and character of the
area, and to enhance the appearance of the development, in accordance with
Policy DM23 of the Councils Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="Default"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">The hereby approved re</span>fuse
and secure and sheltered cycle storage for 2 bicycles per flat located within
the rear garden and outbuilding shall be retained in perpetuity unless by
written agreement by, the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">REASON: To safeguard the character and appearance of the
area in accordance with policy T5 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B
of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></p>
